messages:
Amanda (sales): Hey team — Zenith POC reporting very slow first-token (TTFT) on chat endpoint after ~500 concurrent users. Customer says it spikes after idle periods. Need quick triage + rough cost estimate for prefill/warmup so sales can respond.

Derek - SE: Seen similar when prefill isn't running and batch window is small. Can you paste an example request/approx payload?

Amanda (sales): Example: short system + 3 user turns, ~600 tokens total. They call: `POST /v1/chat/completions` with stream off. Seen TTFT ~1.2s median, jumps to 2.8s on cold shard.

Raj (SRE): Posting quick logs from the prod shard during a cold run:```
[2026-03-21T15:02:11Z] incoming req id=xyz latency=1210ms token-gen-start
[2026-03-21T15:02:11Z] model load check: kvcache=miss prefill=disabled
[2026-03-21T15:02:12Z] batching: started window=10ms collected=3
[2026-03-21T15:02:12Z] first-token-emitted id=xyz ttf=1220ms
```Looks like KV cache misses + shard spin-up. Also seeing `prefill=disabled` flag.

Derek - SE: That `10ms` batch window is likely causing smaller batches after cold start. If prefill is off we pay model cold-load + extra decode overhead. Two quick options: enable prefill/warmup for their route, or increase batch window to 25-50ms to let batching amortize token cost.

Lina (ML Eng): Also check the model variant. We routed them to `redwood/llama-xl-int8` which sometimes has slower decode on our infra vs `redwood/llama-xl-fp16` for short-context workloads. Int8 helps tokens/sec cost but can hurt TTFT if kernel path isn't primed.

Amanda (sales): Sales question: if we enable prefill or reserve warmup cycles, what's the incremental cost estimate? They ask for a ballpark to include in the presentation.

Billing Bot: Quick estimate calc: prefill/warmup adds ~0.03 USD per warmup run for xl-int8 (~300M FLOPS*warmup). If you schedule 1 warmup / 5 minutes for 24h -> ~8.64 USD/day. On Dedicated the marginal cost is lower (opportunity cost), but this gives ballpark.

Derek - SE: Practical immediate steps: 1) enable prefill for their route for next 2 hours, 2) increase batch window to 40ms on that shard, 3) monitor TTFT metrics and token/sec. I can run a quick A/B this afternoon. @Raj can you give write perms for the route?

Raj (SRE): I can toggle prefill. Before we do, small checklist: a) confirm model pin b) ensure prefill concurrency <= route qps to avoid extra tokens c) set a warmup prompt to ~200 tokens representative of real requests. Link to runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/prefill 

Amanda (sales): Confirm pin = `redwood/llama-xl-int8@v2.1`. Warmup prompt: "system + example customer chat ~200 tokens". Go ahead. :thumbsup:

Lina (ML Eng): If we still see TTFT > 1s after prefill + batching, try swapping to `llama-xl-fp16@v2.1` temporarily. Tradeoff: ~12-15% higher token cost but often 30-40% lower TTFT on short chats. I'll run a small perf test on staging.

Derek - SE: Running prefill now against their shard with `--prompt-file warmup_prompt.txt --runs 10 --concurrency 2`. Command:```sh
redwood prefill --route zenith-prod --model redwood/llama-xl-int8@v2.1 --prompt-file warmup_prompt.txt --runs 10
```

ops-bot: Prefill job queued (id=prefill-938). ETA ~45s.

Raj (SRE): Toggling batch window to 40ms on shard `shard-12` now.

Derek - SE: Early numbers after run: TTFT baseline=1.9s -> post-prefill median=540ms, p95 ~1.1s. Batch size avg increased from 1.7 -> 3.9. Looks promising.

Amanda (sales): Great — can you capture a 1-slide summary (expected TTFT improvement + incremental cost)? Customer wants to sign if latency <600ms median.

Derek - SE: I'll drop a quick slide and include the billing estimate. ETA 30m.

Lina (ML Eng): Note for follow-up: if they want persistent <300ms we should discuss Dedicated capacity + pre-warmed model pool; I'll draft the perf vs cost table.

Amanda (sales): Thanks everyone. I'm looping in the account exec for contract talk. If anything regresses ping this thread. :rocket:
